messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Cc: PrIyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: AWS co-sell handshake / stakeholder roadmap for Helix Health

Hi Suresh, Tom —

Thanks for taking this on. Helix Health (Tom) and Redwood have been discussing a pilot to run the inpatient notes extraction workload in prod. Tom, introducing Suresh from AWS PDM to align ACE registration + PDM/PSM intro so we can get the co-sell process moving.

Quick context: Helix expects a Q4 pilot, then a broader rollout in H1 2027 if performance and cost targets are met. Key asks from their side: marketplace listing timeline, procurement checklist, and an initial mutual action plan that lays out contact points and responsibilities.

Proposed next steps:
- Short intro call (30m) this week to introduce PDM/PSM and confirm the ACE intake items.
- Redwood to share an intake form + MAP draft prior to the call.
- AWS to confirm expected listing timeline and any required AWS technical review.

Calendar windows: Wed 9/9 10–12 PT or Thu 9/10 9–11 PT work on our side.

Attaching our intake form and a one-page success criteria doc.

Attachments: redwood_aws_intake_form.xlsx (stub), success_criteria_onepager.pdf (stub)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Redwood Inference — Production-grade inference runtime for developers
From: Suresh Patel <suresh.patel@amazon.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@helixhealth.ai>
Cc: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell handshake / stakeholder roadmap for Helix Health

Hi Kimberly, Tom —

Thanks for the intro, Kimberly. Happy to help. Emily (cc) is our PSM for this region and will join the intake call.

We can do Wed 9/9 at 10:30 PT — I have a 30-minute slot open. During the call we typically:
1) Walk through the ACE intake details; confirm the lead PDM/PSM pair.
2) Validate customer fit for co-sell and marketplace listing prerequisites (security/compliance notes, billing account setup).
3) Agree on an initial MAP with timelines for ACE submission, listing, and joint customer outreach.

Tom — can you confirm who on your side owns procurement and whether you have a standard marketplace procurement flow? If you can share the expected contract vehicle (SOW vs. subscription) that helps us set expectations.

Link to ACE intake portal (for reference): https://console.aws.amazon.com/partner/ace/intake/submit/48291

Warm regards,
Suresh Patel
Partner Development Manager, AWS
suresh.patel@amazon.com

Kimberly, Suresh —

Thanks for looping us in. 10:30 PT on Wed works for me; Alex (cc) will join from our side — he's our cloud procurement lead and will own the marketplace listing questions. To answer Suresh's question: procurement prefers a subscription marketplace purchase but we may need a short SOW for professional services during integration.

Primary success metrics for our pilot are:
- 95% extraction accuracy on clinical notes within a 2s latency SLA for 90thpct requests
- < $0.02/token operational cost target (post-quantization)
- Marketplace procurement completed so pilot is billable via AWS account by end of Q4

I'll attach our procurement outline (internal) so you have context. Looking forward to the call.

Attachments: helix_procurement_requirements.pdf (stub)

Cheers,
Tom Ellis
Director, Cloud Ops | Helix Health
tom.ellis@helixhealth.ai
